landing.headline: Bridging the Digital Health Divide
landing.subheadline: eSanjeevani - National Telemedicine Service of India is a step towards digital health equity to achieve Universal Health Coverage (UHC). It facilitates quick and easy access to doctors and medical specialists from your smartphones or nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir.
landing.step1Desc: Verify mobile no. using OTP and fill patient registration form
landing.step2Desc: Login with mobile no./ABHA ID, provide ailment details and upload records
landing.step3Desc: Select OPD queue, assign doctor and initiate real-time video call
landing.step4Desc: Consult doctor remotely and download instant signed ePrescription
landing.assistedStep1Desc: ASHA registers patient profile offline and captures basic triage vitals
landing.assistedStep2Desc: Assign urgency (Routine / Urgent / Emergency) and select destination facility
landing.assistedStep3Desc: Referral logs and audio notes sync automatically once cellular signal returns
landing.assistedStep4Desc: Medical Officer reviews incoming referral queue and closes consultation loop
landing.cloudDesc: Accessible via internet connectivity across India on any standard computing or mobile device.
landing.assistedDesc: Community Health Officers and ASHA workers facilitate assisted specialist consultations at rural spokes.
landing.abdmDesc: Seamlessly link and manage health records using the 14-digit Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA).
landing.modalAboutDesc: RHAQ (Rural Health Access & Quality) is an offline-capable middleware bridging remote Indian Sub-Centres and ASHA field workers with the national Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) and eSanjeevani infrastructure.
landing.modalAboutCard1Desc: Compliant clinical bundles for national registry integration.
landing.modalAboutCard2Desc: Full speech-to-speech support in English, Hindi, and Marathi.
landing.modalSupportCard2Desc: HIP / HIU API & sandbox technical support
landing.footerNote: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare · National Health Authority · C-DAC
